note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4271 Section 4.3 ('The lower-order four bits of the Attribute Flags octet are unused. They MUST be zero when sent and MUST be ignored when received.') after export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified changes: TestRFC4271RelayedLowNibbleClearedOnBothRails updated only NextHopUnchanged to policychain.BuiltinNextHopUnchanged; test/plugin/rfc4271-attr-flags-low-nibble-relay.ci migrated to bus syntax and next-hop:unchanged export filter (with attr 241 0xC0 on rs-client conn 2 and 0xE0 on plain eBGP conn 3), continuing to inject 0x4F/0xCF low-nibble flags and require exact relayed UPDATE frames with 0x0F cleared on both peers. Unchanged message/rfc4271_test.go units TestRFC4271AttrFlagsLowNibbleIgnoredOnReceive (positive, ActionNone on 0x4F) and TestRFC4271AttrFlagsHighBitsNotIgnored (negative, exact TreatAsWithdraw + AttrCode 1 on 0xCF optional and 0x0F non-transitive ORIGIN) continue to isolate low-nibble ignoring from defined high bits.
